risks.risk: Heating element or magnetron may not function despite display lighting up
risks.proof: Short video of microwave heating a cup of water, showing steam/boil after 1-2 minutes

risks.risk: Turntable motor or glass plate missing/broken
risks.proof: Photo of open interior showing turntable plate and motor coupler

risks.risk: Interior damage, rust, or burn marks
risks.proof: Clear interior photo with lighting, all angles

risks.risk: Power cord or plug damage/non-standard plug
risks.proof: Close-up photo of plug and full cord length

risks.risk: Unknown age and usage history affecting lifespan
risks.proof: Photo of rating label/serial sticker (usually inside door or back) showing manufacture date
Photo of rating label showing watts and liter capacity
risks.if_unproven: priced at lowest common capacity/wattage tier

risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced as base unit only, no accessories

risks.risk: Hidden odors or interior residue not visible in photo
risks.proof: Not provable remotely; would need in-person check or buyer-side video with narration
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming needs cleaning/unknown odor risk

risks.risk: Guarantee claim unverifiable, could be void or informal
risks.proof: Photo of physical warranty card/receipt with date and seller/shop name
risks.if_unproven: priced as if no guarantee exists

proof_requests: Video of microwave running a full heat cycle on a cup of water
Interior photo showing turntable, walls, and door seal clearly
Close-up of rating label (wattage, capacity, serial/date)
Photo of power cord and plug in full
Photo of warranty card or proof of guarantee if claimed
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a Samsung microwave, so it can be priced at worst case given unverified functional and condition claims; seller's assurances are unverifiable remotely and do not raise the price without supporting photos/video.
